coordinates: Ulam ulamCoord(n) divided by fixed ring radius. Sphere toDisplay(conePoints(n)) at scale 1.1/N, camera [.55,.45,3.5], target zero, up [0,1,0], FOV42. Projected x/y in vertical image units.

definitions.density: abs Spearman(equal-volume bin counts, x/y or distance from fixed center); 16 bins per axis; zeros retained
definitions.modality: 128-bin Gaussian KDE on fixed support; sigma6 bins, constant zero padding, peak prominence10% maximum, minimum distance12 bins
definitions.reflection: 1-total variation of histogram and fixed-axis reflection; 128 bins in 1D, 32x32 joint bins in 2D
definitions.spacing_ks: two-sample KS of exported histogram spacings; direction from empirical CDF sign at maximum absolute difference; not a claim of stochastic dominance

exclusions.colour_class: Sphere classColour depends on n mod q, but no colour-class check is in this packet; force identical plain colour on all sources.
exclusions.curve_shape/outline/ellipse: prime-sphere.js guides(o,d) draws meridians, parallels and the rim curve from o/d.rates without sel.n; suppress guides in blinded redraw.
exclusions.grid/axis/frame: research.js chart line() and field-phase3-overlay.js panel strokeRect() are independent of samples; suppressed while blind; existing WO-1 text masks retained.
exclusions.histogram_peak/histogram_tail: Absolute peak location and an undefined right tail are not v3 differences; replace only well-defined peak COUNT with modality_x; no tail-region substitution.
exclusions.intersection: The Viviani crossing ray/marker and origin point are fixed guides, suppressed with guides().
exclusions.panel_layout: Dyson layout() uses only canvas dimensions; drop entire left panel; panel layout cannot be a feature.
exclusions.reference_curve: Dyson side overlay draws fixed montgomery/goePairCorrelation/wignerGUE/wignerGOE/poissonSpacing curves; line() suppressed while blind.
exclusions.void/point_cluster/spiral_arm/symmetry_a: Broad v2 labels are ambiguous or can refer to coordinate support shared by both arms; use density/modality/joint reflection numeric checks only. Data-dependent differences in these features remain allowed.

limitations: Density uses gradient magnitude, not signed inward/outward direction.
Reflection center and KDE bandwidth fixed before scoring; no axis fitting.
Common renderer geometry is not banned if a data-dependent difference can be tested.
Checks use whole exported samples; a local feature alone cannot establish the whole-sample claim.
